title: Three demo-reachable mutation paths bypass demo_api and hit the REAL api modules (bulk-reject x2, confirmed vacancy update)
detail: demo_update.handle does not intercept UserClickedMarkAllRejected/UserClickedMarkSelectedRejected/UserConfirmedVacancyUpdate (line 1831 calls vacancy_api.update_vacancy with no demo branch), so these fall through to update_inner and fire real HTTP writes with csrf "demo-csrf-token". demo_api.bulk_reject_applications/demo_store.bulk_reject exist but are never called. The CI lint only greps client/src/demo/, so it cannot catch leaks from client.gleam. Reachable in demo: select mode (?mode=select) and editing The Maples (active, 8 applicants, tier-2 change → warning modal → confirm). Violates the 'demo issues no writes to real endpoints' pillar.
recommended_fix: Intercept UserClickedMarkAllRejected/UserClickedMarkSelectedRejected in demo_update (wire demo_api.bulk_reject_applications, threading the returned store) and add a demo branch (or demo_update arm) for UserConfirmedVacancyUpdate.

title: Demo create/edit-vacancy and mark-opened discard the mutated store (`let _ = next`) — mutations silently lost
detail: DemoStore is an immutable Gleam record; demo_api.create_vacancy/update_vacancy/mark_application_opened return #(next_store, eff) and all three client.gleam demo branches (5959, 6161, 6275, plus mark-opened at 2537) discard next_store. Consequences: creating a draft never appears on the demo dashboard; creating active navigates to /vacancies/v-demo-*/handoff whose get_detail against the stale store returns Error; edits refetch pre-edit data under a 'Vacancy updated.' toast; opening a Submitted application never transitions it to UnderReview. Breaks acceptance item 1 (create/edit clickable in demo). The #(DemoStore, Effect) return shape (unlike the real api's Effect-only) is what invited the misuse.
recommended_fix: Set Model(..model, demo_store: Some(next)) in each of the four demo branches (submit_vacancy, both handle_vacancy_update sites, mark_application_opened), or route these submissions through demo_update which already threads the store correctly.

title: Duplicated store-fallback helper (demo_store_of in client.gleam, store_of in demo_update.gleam) silently re-seeds on invariant violation
detail: Identical logic exists as demo_store_of in client.gleam. Two copies of an invariant-repair helper drift independently, and the silent re-seed would wipe a user's demo session rather than surfacing the broken invariant. DRY rule (2+ places) applies.
recommended_fix: Export one helper from demo_store (or demo_api) and call it from both sites; consider logging on the None path so the invariant violation is visible.

title: Demo mode still reads/writes the real app's localStorage (sweep-nudge dismissals, comparison ids)
detail: demo_update does not intercept UserDismissedSweepNudge, so demo dismissals persist to rt_dismissed_sweep_nudges beyond refresh (harmless ids, but contradicts the pure in-memory claim). Similarly demo_entry_effects uses load_comparison_ids() for a /compare deep link, bleeding real comparison ids into the demo fetch, and navigation clears comparison ids via save_comparison_ids([]).
recommended_fix: Intercept UserDismissedSweepNudge in demo_update (model-only, no save), and use [] instead of load_comparison_ids() in demo_entry_effects' Comparison branch.
